threads.body: The PR description mentions the workflow failing in a `validate_multi_secret.sh` step when `COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN` is unavailable, but the regenerated lock workflow no longer includes that secret-validation step (or the related `secret_verification_result` output). If the goal is still to fail fast with a clear error when the token is missing/misconfigured, consider reintroducing secret validation in an `environment: protected` job (or update the PR description to reflect the new behavior).

replies.body: The validate-secret step isn't missing because this PR removed it — `gh-aw` omits the runtime `validate_multi_secret.sh` preflight (and the `secret_verification_result` output) whenever the workflow declares `environment: protected`, since the environment gate already enforces secret presence. Same shape as the compiled `module-cleanup.lock.yml`, which also has no validate-secret step.
